main_text.l: ta: Siquidem in Logica nunc, præ-ter Anomaliæ Typos,quos paulo ante commemoravi, nihil ferió tractatur : hi soli præcipuè spectantur ibi, explicantur ibi, inculcantur ibi,& in usum,in habilitatem ac Naturam quodammodo crebris exercitiis deducuntur;Cætera tantum incidunt, tamquam præludia, tamquam antecœnia, & quod eo conferre aliquid, aliquid eam in rem facere quoquo modo videantur. Res igitur in Parergon, Discursus in excursum , Logica in Paralogismum conversa est ; Sed heus erro ! Metamorphosim non patitur illa Forma, Divina est : Et homines quidem in alias formas mutatos, in Poëtis legimus ; non Deos : illud volui dicere, Paralo-gismum ab ignaris coli pro Logica, illum hujus loco suffectum ab incautis ; Logicam illibatâ gratiâ &

page.notes: The text ends with "&" and the catchword "in-" stands alone at the lower right. The strip at the right edge shows cropped text from the facing page; it is not transcribed. "Anomaliæ" is set in small capitals in the print and is shown in italics here as a marked word. Some words in the lower right corner are slightly blurred; no readings are doubtful.
